_comment: 设计语言 / 布光预设库（大纲 §4）。只定义「怎么把已有几何拍好」——布光、机位、背景、反射组织、边缘高光、阴影、细节优先级，**绝不描述 CAD 中不存在的结构**（不加筋条、不加倒角、不加开孔）。
_usage: web/server.py 的 GET /api/designs 提供给前端；出图时把 design.prompt 追加到正向提示词、design.negative 合并进负面提示词。没有选设计预设时行为与以前完全一致。
_adr: ADR-002：丝印 / LOGO / 刻度 / 量程 / 认证标识 / 透明件一律不在这里描述，仍由真渲染 + 图层回贴负责。
_negative_common_note: 所有设计预设共用的额外负面约束：抑制 AI「补结构」。原项目 NEGATIVE 已含 invented text / fake logo，这里补的是工业品特有的臆造件。
negative_common: fake glossy reflections on matte surfaces

presets.name: 精密仪器
presets.summary: 高控制力布光，强调尺寸精度与加工质感；表面干净、反射克制，适合激光水平仪、测距仪一类量测工具。
presets.lighting: large softbox key at 45° from upper left, weak fill from the right, tight rim light along both edges
presets.background: light neutral grey seamless, subtle vertical gradient, no visible horizon
presets.reflection: controlled reflections only — long narrow highlights on metal trim, low-contrast sheen on plastic
presets.edge_highlight: thin continuous specular line along chamfers and part boundaries to read the silhouette
presets.shadow: soft contact shadow directly under the base, short and dense, no cast shadow across the background
detail_priority: material contrast between plastic and metal
presets.prompt: Precision instrument product photography; large softbox key light from upper left with tight rim light along both edges; controlled narrow highlights on metal trim and low-contrast sheen on plastic; thin continuous specular line along chamfers to read the silhouette; soft short contact shadow under the base; light neutral grey seamless background with subtle vertical gradient; sharp focus across the whole product; industrial metrology grade presentation.

presets.name: 户外耐用
presets.summary: 略强方向感的户外光，材质对比更明确，突出抗摔、防水、耐候的气质；不改结构，只改光照与质感表达。
presets.lighting: single directional key from upper right with clear falloff, cool sky fill, distinct rim on the shadow side
presets.background: matte dark grey or weathered concrete-like seamless surface, slight texture, blurred
presets.reflection: broader but still diffused highlights; rubber and grip areas read flat and non-reflective
presets.edge_highlight: strong rim light to separate the product from a darker background
presets.shadow: longer directional contact shadow to imply outdoor sun angle
presets.prompt: Rugged outdoor product photography; single directional key light from upper right with clear falloff, cool sky fill and a distinct rim on the shadow side; broader diffused highlights, flat non-reflective rubber grip areas; strong rim light separating the product from a darker matte background; longer directional contact shadow implying an outdoor sun angle; weathered matte surface with subtle texture, blurred; durable industrial tool presentation.

presets.name: 实验室设备
presets.summary: 干净、均匀、无色彩倾向的临床感布光，适合强调读数、面板与洁净材质。
presets.lighting: even overhead diffusion plus two symmetric side fills, near-shadowless key, no colour cast
presets.background: pure white or very light cool grey seamless, absolutely even
presets.reflection: soft broad highlights occupying at most a third of each surface, no hot spots
presets.edge_highlight: minimal — silhouette carried by slight tonal separation rather than a specular line
presets.shadow: very faint even contact shadow, almost ambient
presets.prompt: Clinical laboratory equipment photography; even overhead diffusion with two symmetric side fills producing a near-shadowless key and no colour cast; soft broad highlights covering no more than a third of any surface with no hot spots; minimal edge specular, silhouette carried by gentle tonal separation; very faint even contact shadow; pure white seamless background; absolutely even and dust-free presentation.

presets.name: 克制高端工业极简
presets.summary: 低对比、大留白、只靠材质与边缘高光说话；适合做主图或品牌调性图。
presets.lighting: one very large bounceless soft source overhead-left, extremely soft gradient falloff, no secondary source
presets.background: near-flat light grey with generous empty space around the product
presets.reflection: single long soft highlight running along the main body, everything else matte
presets.edge_highlight: subtle, only on the upper-left facing chamfer
presets.shadow: minimal diffuse shadow, no hard edges, low opacity
presets.prompt: Restrained high-end industrial minimalism; one very large soft overhead-left source with extremely soft gradient falloff and no secondary source; single long soft highlight along the main body with everything else fully matte; subtle edge highlight only on the upper-left chamfer; minimal diffuse low-opacity shadow; near-flat light grey background with generous empty space around the product; quiet, expensive, brand-level presentation.

presets.name: 局部工艺特写
presets.summary: 近距离展示现有加工痕迹（拉丝方向、注塑纹、倒角高光、材质交界），用于详情页工艺说明位。
presets.lighting: low-angle grazing light to reveal surface micro-structure, one soft fill to keep shadows open
presets.reflection: grazing highlights that follow the actual machining direction
presets.edge_highlight: crisp highlight along chamfers and the material transition line
presets.shadow: tight contact shadow under the featured detail only
presets.prompt: Close-up process detail photography of an existing surface; low-angle grazing light revealing surface micro-structure with one soft fill keeping shadows open; grazing highlights following the actual machining direction; crisp highlight along chamfers and material transition lines; tight contact shadow under the featured detail; uncluttered out-of-focus neutral background; macro-level focus on the existing finish, no added geometry.
negative: shallow depth of field hiding the detail
